messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: latency_p99 > 2.5s for route /v1/chat.completions (last 5m) — 18 alerts in 10m. Paging on-call: @sasha

sasha: oncall here, looking. seeing p99 spike across multiple regions. paging noise is high. starting triage.

kevin: saw it too. initial hypothesis: request fanout to reranker + long context models causing tail latency. no 5xx spike though — just slow responses.

meera: tagging routing team — any recent rollout or routing changes? I didn't see infra deploys in the last hour.

alex: Runtime uploaded a micro-change to kv-cache eviction yesterday but it was canaryed. not sure it would hit all these models.

zoe: Product: customer impact check — any live customers complaining? support shows a couple CRM customers with partial slow UX but not full failures.

ops-bot: note: 1775324680 incident created, severity: S2 (service degradation).

sasha: ok — immediate goals: 1) stop alert noise (we're getting paging for every p99 blip) 2) confirm whether customer-facing QoS is affected 3) implement short mitigation (if safe). Suggestions?

kevin: propose temporary adjustment: widen p99 threshold for route /v1/chat.completions from 2.5s to 3.5s for 30m while we investigate. also add per-model p99s so tiny models (e.g., gpt-small) don't inherit same threshold as gpt-xl.

meera: +1 for per-model split. Current alert rule is global across the route which is too coarse post model-mix changes. We should add labels model_name and route in the metric aggregation.

sasha: can we make that change without causing config drift? I prefer a short-lived override via alertmanager silence or a dynamic rule change with rollback.

kevin: easiest quick fix is an Alertmanager silence for the noisy alert group and then submit a proper rule change. silence duration 45m so on-call isn't paged while we push fixes. I'll create silence.

sasha: do it. also create a non-paging alias in parallel: alerts at p95 -> slack only, p99 -> pager. if p95 is informative only we don't need to page.

kevin: created silence: /alerts/group/latency_chat_completions — expires in 45m. added p95->#eng-platform channel route.

meera: working on Grafana dashboard changes now: adding a panel showing p50/p95/p99 by model_name and by route. will also add an anomaly band and historical baseline (last 7 days). 

alex: Runtime team: I'll instrument per-model kv-cache hit rate and tail Q latency breakdown (queue, compute, io). attaching sample query: ```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/chat.completions"}[5m])) by (le, model_name))
```

kevin: thanks. also adding a temporary per-model escalation map: for model in (gpt-xl, gpt-large): p99 threshold 3.0s; for smaller models p99 threshold 1.2s; route-level fallback 3.5s. This is just for immediate noise reduction, we'll refine after postmortem.

zoe: from product POV, we should avoid hiding real regressions. Can we set alert conditions to require increased error-rate or increased client-side timeouts before paging? I.e., page only if p99>threshold AND >2% of requests exceed threshold.

sasha: good call. we'll add a compound alert: pager fires only if both latency and request volume anomaly are present. KeVin, can you implement this in the rule?

kevin: yes — adding grouped condition: (p99_latency > X) and (sum(rate(requests_exceeding_latency[5m])) / sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) > 0.02). pushing to staging rule now.

meera: pushed new dashboard panels to staging. screenshot link: https://grafana.internal/r/AKJ3/p99-by-model (placeholder).

alex: observed node-level GC spikes on 3 hosts at approx t-20m, correlates with increased queue time. will open infra ticket to investigate JVM tuning on the transformer preprocessor.

sasha: summary of actions so far: 1) silence global noisy alert (kevin) 2) route p95->slack, p99->pager (kevin) 3) create per-model p99 thresholds (kevin/meera) 4) create dashboard panels (meera) 5) instrument kv-cache & queue breakdown (alex) 6) require volume condition for paging (kevin)

ops-bot: note: follow-up task created INF-2351 "Latency alerting: per-model p99 split + compound paging condition" assigned to eng-platform.

zoe: customer comms: we'll prepare a short note if we see sustained impact >30m. right now it's intermittent.

sasha: handoff: I'm going offline in 30m. @kevin you'll take next shift — confirm you have alert visibility after silence expires.

kevin: ack. will monitor the new staging rule then promote. will also set a 2h retrospective check to decide permanent thresholds.

meera: FYI I'm planning a design doc for longer-term: adaptive thresholds per-route using 95th percentile rolling baseline + seasonality adjustment, and a per-model SLO definition. will attach to INF-2351.

alex: infra ticket INF-2352 opened for GC analysis and node isolation.

kevin: promoted staged alert rule to prod at ts 1775328000 (rolled out with an automated check). No immediate pager after promotion; monitoring.

meera: dashboards updated in prod. added annotations for silences and rule rollout.

sasha: quick customer impact check: support flagged 6 tickets in last 45m, all report UI slow but no failures. recommend no customer-wide outage label.

kevin: leaving a snippet of the new alert rule we used: ```yaml
- alert: ChatCompletionsHighP99
  expr: |
    (
      histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/chat.completions"}[5m])) by (le, model_name))
    ) > on(model_name) (label_replace(vector(3.0), "threshold", "3.0", "", ""))
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "p99 high for chat.completions by model"
```

kevin: (that's simplified — real rule uses rate-of-requests fraction check as mentioned).

sasha: follow-ups for post-incident: - formalize per-model SLOs - evaluate autoscaling/tail mitigation (shard affinity, prefetch) - decide permanent thresholds (p95/p99) by model tier - run a synthetic load test to validate rules

meera: scheduling a review session tomorrow 10:00 to decide threshold matrix. will invite product and runtime.

zoe: I'll bring the customer usage cohorts to decide thresholds that balance UX vs noise.

sasha: thanks all. will close the incident when silence expires and no further pager. leaving notes in INF-2351.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: silence expires in 15m. incident status: monitoring.

kevin: monitoring shows p99 back near baseline for most models except gpt-xl which still has occasional spikes. keeping an eye.

ops-bot: incident 1775324680: status moved to MONITORING -> action_required: false.

sasha: closing from my side. if anything flares up, remind oncall to escalate.

kevin: thanks — will run postmortem with data and threshold proposal in INF-2351.

meera: uploading dashboard snapshots and queries to the ticket.

zoe: noted. will prep customer comms template in case we need it tomorrow."
